topics.description: The federal government has deferred $91 million in Minnesota Medicaid funding due to fraud vulnerabilities. This is part of a larger trend of increased scrutiny on Medicaid funding and fraud prevention.
topics.reason: Medicaid funding deferrals are trending due to increased concerns over fraud and abuse

topics.reason: Illinois school investigations are trending due to concerns over educational policies
